note: lull's live model for themes (ADR-0101, docs/themes.md section 14). Each value is a dotted path; its type gives its forms: text and number are words in data-bind and a custom property (--path-with-dashes) on the live hosts, a state also an attribute on :root (data-path-with-dashes), a flag only that attribute (true, false) and a number 1 or 0. pace is how often it can change. The hub lists in a theme's manifest the values its CSS and slots name, and the page publishes only those. Adding a value keeps the theme api; renaming or removing one breaks it. After editing, LULL_WRITE_PACKAGES=1 cargo test -p lull-themes writes web/designs/live.js's copy.

clock.time.about: the time as the device writes it: 14:12, or 2:12 PM

clock.second.about: 0 to 59; as words two digits. The only clock value that changes every second, so name it only to show seconds

clock.weekday.about: as words, the day's name in the device's language: Sunday

clock.date.about: the day of the month, 1 to 31

clock.month.about: 1 to 12; as words, the month's name in the device's language: November

clock.daypart.about: morning from 5:00, afternoon from 12:00, evening from 18:00, night from 22:00, as Home's greeting has them

song.title.about: the playing song's title; empty while nothing plays

song.year.about: its album's year, when lull knows it

song.from.about: the place it plays from, as the player bar names it: Liked songs, a playlist's name

song.source.about: where the copy that plays comes from

song.quality.about: the copy's quality as its chip says it: FLAC 16/44.1, MP3 320

song.format.about: the file's facts: FLAC :: 44.1 kHz, 1123 kbps, 32.8 MB

song.lossless.about: the copy that plays is lossless

song.saved.about: it is saved in the library

song.pos.about: where the song is, 0 to 1 in hundredths (as --song-pos); as words a percentage

song.elapsed.about: the time played: 1:23. Changes every second, so name it only to show it

song.buffered.about: how far it is buffered, 0 to 1 in hundredths; as words a percentage

song.received.about: how much of the file has arrived, 0 to 1 in hundredths; as words a percentage

song.hue.about: a hue for decoration, 0 to 359, the same for a song every time

song.seed.about: a number for decoration, 0 to 1 in thousandths, the same for a song every time

song.title-length.about: how many characters its title has, to size type by

next.title.about: the song after it in the queue; empty at the end

next.saved.about: it is saved in the library

queue.1.title.about: the song 1 after the playing one

queue.2.title.about: the song 2 after the playing one

queue.3.title.about: the song 3 after the playing one

queue.4.title.about: the song 4 after the playing one

queue.5.title.about: the song 5 after the playing one

queue.6.title.about: the song 6 after the playing one

queue.7.title.about: the song 7 after the playing one

queue.8.title.about: the song 8 after the playing one

queue.count.about: how many songs come after the playing one

queue.left.about: how long they play for: 1 h 12 min

player.status.about: the player's state, as :root[data-player] has it

player.status-text.about: the state's own words, as --status-text has them: Streaming from YouTube, a failure's reason

player.volume.about: 0 to 1 in hundredths; as words a percentage

player.crossfading.about: a crossfade into the next song is under way

player.private.about: private listening is on: nothing played here is recorded

app.screen.about: the screen showing, as .app[data-screen]: home, now, search, album, playlist, settings...

app.ctx.about: the side panel: docked, open or closed, as .app[data-ctx]

app.size.about: the main area's width class, as .app[data-size]

services.soulseek.about: the soulseek service, as its tray pill says it

services.library.about: the library service, as its tray pill says it

services.lastfm.about: the lastfm service, as its tray pill says it

services.catalog.about: the catalog service, as its tray pill says it

services.cache.about: the cache service, as its tray pill says it

week.time.about: time listened in the last 7 days: 12 h 40 min, once Stats has read it

week.plays.about: songs played in the last 7 days

week.artists.about: artists heard in the last 7 days

week.peak.about: the hour of day listened to most, 0 to 23

region.width.about: each region's own width in px, on that region alone (a number: calc(var(--region-width) * 1px))

region.height.about: each region's own height in px, on that region alone
